sloka: धिगस्तु हृदयं यस्या ममेदं न सहस्रधा ।त्वयि मञ्चत्वमापन्ने फलते शोकपीडितम् ।। ६.११४.८६ ।।
transliteration: dhigastu hṛdayaṁ yasyā mamedaṁ na sahasradhā ।tvayi mañcatvamāpanne phalate śokapīḍitam ।। 6.114.86 ।।

translations.english: "You are lying in the battlefield embracing it as if it is a loved one. Why are you not willing to answer me?"
